summary: ICICI Bank Limited filed a Form 6-K providing transcripts of its media conference call and earnings call with analysts and investors regarding financial results for the quarter and fiscal year ended March 31, 2026. This is a routine disclosure by a foreign issuer under Rule 13a-16 or 15d-16, not a special situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change is involved. The filing simply disseminates already-announced earnings call transcripts to U.S. holders, with no terms, structural mechanics, or risk arbitrage angle.
